references.text: The prophecy in Isaiah about the sufferings of the Messiah and how he will be rejected and suffer for humanity's sins.

Jesus predicts his suffering, death, and resurrection to the disciples, parallel to Mark 8:31.
Jesus explains that the Son of Man must suffer greatly, be rejected, killed, and rise on the third day, parallel to Mark 8:31.
